# Tasneem Knitting Industry

> Industrial Circular Knitting, Dyeing, Shearing & Finishing Machinery Direct Importer in Bangladesh

Tasneem Knitting Industry (স্বত্বাধিকারী: মোঃ মামুনুর রশীদ) is a specialized direct overseas machinery importer and supplier based in Narayanganj and Dhaka, Bangladesh. The company sources high-efficiency industrial textile machinery directly from established manufacturers in China and Taiwan for composite textile mills, export knitwear factories, and knitting units across Bangladesh.

## Core Capabilities & Machinery Sourcing
- **Circular Knitting Machines**: Single Jersey (high-speed 3/4-track), Double Jersey (interlock/rib), Electronic Jacquard, Terry Loop Wheel, and Fleece machinery. Gauges range from 14G to 44G with cylinder diameters from 30" to 44".
- **Dyeing Machinery**: High-efficiency, low-liquor ratio soft-flow fabric dyeing vessels and package dyeing machines.
- **Shearing Machinery**: Precision rotary blade fabric surface shearing machines for polar fleece, velvet, and terry toweling.
- **Finishing Equipment**: Tubular and open-width stenters, compactors, and fabric inspection tables.
- **OEM Spare Parts**: Groz-Beckert needles, precision sinkers, positive yarn feeders, ceramic yarn guides, and frequency inverters.

## Commercial, Shipping & Payment Terms
- **Delivery Terms**: CFR Chattogram (Cost and Freight to Chittagong Sea Port, Bangladesh).
- **Payment Terms**: Commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) opened through Bangladesh scheduled banks. Zero broker markups or hidden fees.
- **Pre-Shipment Quality Control**: 3rd-party pre-shipment inspection (SGS, Intertek, or Bureau Veritas) verifying cylinder concentricity, cam box metallurgy, motor calibration, and container stuffing.
- **Commissioning & Support**: Full on-site factory installation, leveling, trial knitting, technical operator handover, and warranty support in Narayanganj, Gazipur, Savar, Chattogram, and Mymensingh.

## Published Technical Articles & Market Insights
- [Single Jersey vs Double Jersey Circular Knitting Machines](https://tasneemknitindustry.com/blog/single-jersey-vs-double-jersey-circular-knitting-machines-bangladesh): Engineering comparison of single jersey 4-track vs double jersey interlock/rib machines for Bangladesh mills.
- [10 Technical Checks Before Opening Machinery L/C](https://tasneemknitindustry.com/blog/top-10-technical-checks-circular-knitting-machine-import-lc): Pre-import engineering checklist covering cylinder concentricity, cam metallurgy, and seaworthy packing.
- [Groz-Beckert Needles & Sinker Replacement Protocol](https://tasneemknitindustry.com/blog/groz-beckert-needles-sinker-replacement-routine-circular-knitting): How needle hook fatigue and sinker wear cause fabric holes and drop stitches, with local Narayanganj stock benefits.
- [HS Code 8447 Classification & 1% Customs Duty Guide](https://tasneemknitindustry.com/blog/hs-code-8447-customs-duty-concession-machinery-import-bangladesh): Utilizing NBR capital machinery statutory orders for 1% customs duty clearance at Chattogram Port.
- [Low-Liquor Ratio Soft-Flow Dyeing (1:4.5) vs Conventional](https://tasneemknitindustry.com/blog/low-liquor-ratio-soft-flow-dyeing-slashing-water-gas-costs): Cutting water, boiler steam, and ETP effluent costs by up to 40% in Bangladesh composite mills.
- [10-Machine Knitting Unit Floor Layout & Power Plan](https://tasneemknitindustry.com/blog/optimal-floor-layout-electrical-load-circular-knitting-factory-bangladesh): Floor space dimensions (3.8m x 3.8m bay), screw compressor CFM, and humidity standards (65-70% RH).
- [Preventing Lycra Crease Marks: Open-Width vs Tubular](https://tasneemknitindustry.com/blog/preventing-crease-marks-lycra-cotton-open-width-circular-knitting): Overcoming permanent edge fold marks and bowing in cotton-spandex stretch fabrics with motorized slitters.
- [Why Narayanganj Remains Bangladesh's Knitting Capital](https://tasneemknitindustry.com/blog/why-narayanganj-remains-bangladesh-knitwear-circular-knitting-hub): BSCIC industrial estate, Fatullah clusters, master mechanic availability, and same-day spare parts access.
